events.text: DATA-LOSS BUG (critique round 5): PAINT WIPES ON UNHIDE. Repro: paint mode -> two parts -> hide one via outliner eye -> paint the visible part -> unhide -> the new paint is WIPED. Hypothesis (grounded in known behavior, verify): hide/show journals a full snapshot host-side (journalSnapshotCurrent 'hide part'/'show part', gpu/3d.zig) AND/OR the shared whole-model atlas re-lays when the visible face set changes (same re-layout class as addpart shuffling islands, gap PP) — strokes painted against the hidden-state layout are dropped or land on stale coords when unhide re-lays. Same disease family as the req_2611/2613 tint-bake fixes (suspend/resume discipline around atlas rebuild/overwrite). Priority: HIGH — silent loss of user work. QUEUED as lead item of the next wave (with req_2659 multi-select): ModelView and 3d.zig are owned by live cleanup agents right now. ALSO user re-notes: UV panel still floating + manual refresh in current build — that is agent-in-flight (OO relocation + live-scoped UV), expected to land this wave; verify the live-refresh signal also fires on hide/show when it lands.

FIXED (9b3d1f878). Real root cause: hide/show -> replaceActiveEditMesh -> setPaintTarget -> model_paint.setTarget -> clear() destroyed the atlas BEFORE refreshPaintLayout ran; the rebuild only carried per-face centroid color, so every sub-face stroke wiped on EVERY eye toggle. Fix: island-level texel carry surviving the mid-op clear (snapshotAtlasForCarry/consumeAtlasCarry in model_paint.zig, blit old-rect->new-rect per matched authored group, nearest-resample on density change). PIL-verified: 288 red + 24288 green px exactly preserved across hide->paint->unhide with atlas re-layout 132x196 -> 198x262. UV panel refreshes on hide/show. LEFT OPEN (queued to painter wave): loop cut/extrude/detach still lose strokes (same carry could extend); paint_program dabs are face-indexed and shift across hides — program SAVED while hidden replays misindexed.
